resources.string: Learn the real dry and wet values of a new sensor
Teach the sensor your garden conditions
The wizard collects five current readings in dry and wet conditions. It stores the median of stable samples instead of trusting one reading.
Safety: Automatic irrigation for this zone is paused while measuring and restored after saving or cancelling.
Assign a sensor in Zone Management
No sensor assigned to a zone is available for calibration.
This sensor is disabled in the app. Enable it in Zone Management first.
Waiting for the first current sensor reading…
Sensor data is not current. Check the ESP32 and its connection.
Live sensor data is being received.
Place the probe section in completely dry soil. Start measuring after the reading has been stable for a few seconds.
Place the probe section in water-saturated soil. Keep the electronics and connector dry; start after the reading stabilizes.
Five current samples will be collected automatically after measurement starts.
Collecting current samples from dry soil…
Collecting current samples from wet soil…
The reading is not stable yet (spread %1$d). Hold the sensor still and restart this step.
The result will be validated after dry and wet measurements are complete.
The dry value must be at least 500 higher than the wet value. Check the sensor positions and repeat both measurements.
Waiting for current sensor data before measurement can start.
This zone is watering or queued. Wait until irrigation has completely finished.
The zone record is invalid. Assign the sensor again in Zone Management.
Automatic irrigation was safely paused for calibration.
Automatic irrigation could not be paused safely, so calibration was not started.
Calibration saved and the previous irrigation setting was restored.
Calibration could not be saved. Automatic irrigation may remain off for safety; check the connection and retry.
Collected values will be discarded and the previous automatic irrigation setting will be restored.
The previous irrigation setting could not be restored. Irrigation remains off for safety; check Zone Settings.
